usedFor: Shopify holds the store's products, and LC.CX makes a short link for each through “Create Short Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Short Link” in LC.CX
bestTemplate.why: Each new product can get a short link with a custom path, tags and a note.

watchOut: “Create Short Link” can set an expiration, so check any expiry you add before a product link goes live.
